nu.nothing_found: 🔎 {query} Nothing found. Try a shorter name.
nu.ask_time: 🍽 {meal} What time did you eat? Type a time, for example 13:30, or choose below.
nu.add_product_short: 🍽 Add a product 🔎 Type a name or open your favorite, recent or own products.
nu.time_invalid: Type the time like 08:30 or press “Current time”.
nu.type_name: Type a product name or part of it.
bc.scan: 📷 Barcode Send a photo of the product's barcode — sharp, filling most of the frame. Or type the digits under the barcode.
bc.retry: Couldn't read the barcode. Send a sharper photo: closer, straight, without glare or blur. Or type the digits under it.
bc.warning.per_100ml: Values are per 100 ml. In millilitres the tracking is exact; in grams 1 g = 1 ml is assumed.
bc.warning.converted_from_serving: Some values were converted from the serving to 100 g using the serving weight from the label.
bc.warning.energy_mismatch: Calories clearly don't match the macros — compare with the label.
bc.warning.no_nutrition_data: The database says the package has no nutrition information.
bc.warning.basis_uncertain: It is unknown whether the values are per 100 g or per 100 ml — compare with the label.
bc.field.name: name
bc.source: Source: Open Food Facts — community data, not verified by NosiFit.
bc.stale: Open Food Facts is unavailable right now — showing previously saved data.
bc.check_and_add: Compare the values with the label and add the product.
bc.not_enough: This data is not enough for tracking. Create your own product from the label.
bc.not_found: 📷 Barcode {code} This product is neither in the NosiFit catalog nor in Open Food Facts. Create your own product from the label — next time it will be found by this barcode.
bc.send_photo: Send a photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP) with a barcode.
bc.too_many: Too many photos in a row. Try again in a minute.
bc.too_big: The file is too large. Send a regular barcode photo (up to 10 MB).
bc.download_failed: Couldn't get the photo. Try again or type the digits under the barcode.
bc.imported: ✅ The product was added to “My products” — if the data is inaccurate, change it with the ✏️ button.
bc.own_title: ➕ My product with barcode {code}{hint} Enter the product name, then the values from the label per 100 g.
